本报告比较已暴露历史上的固定算法，不重新训练或选择最优种子。
各算法联合决定七场组与赛果购买；预算相同不代表实际投入相同。
本金10万元，每期上限1024元，每票2元，北单回款仅折算一次0.65。
FUNDED在资金不足以支付整期计划后持有现金；SHADOW仅供诊断，不代表可执行账户。

```{r}
library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(readr);library(ggplot2)
cfg<-jsonlite::fromJSON(params$config);root<-cfg$repository_root
modules<-c('n7_purchase_settle','joint_candidate_comparison','top2_fresh_groups',
 'diagnostic_verified_csv','fundamentals_equity_curves','n7_purchase_accounting',
 'legacy_strategy_comparison','eight_strategy_validation')
code_files<-c(paste0('r/',modules,'.R'),'quarto/229_eight_strategy_history_report.qmd')
code<-setNames(lapply(code_files,function(f)digest::digest(file=file.path(root,f),algo='sha256')),code_files)
for(n in modules)source(file.path(root,'r',paste0(n,'.R')))
stopifnot(!dir.exists(cfg$output))
receipts<-list()
for(k in c('joint','top2')) {
 path<-cfg[[k]]$receipt
 stopifnot(digest::digest(file=path,algo='sha256')==cfg[[k]]$sha256)
 receipts[[k]]<-jsonlite::fromJSON(path,simplifyVector=FALSE)
 stopifnot(receipts[[k]]$status=='FROZEN_NOT_SETTLED')
}
issues<-unlist(receipts$joint$config$issues)
requested_issues<-issues
model_label<-receipts$top2$config$settings$model_id
scope_path<-receipts$top2$config$scope
stopifnot(digest::digest(file=scope_path,algo='sha256')==receipts$top2$config$scope_sha256)
scope<-jsonlite::fromJSON(scope_path);source_version<-NULL
if(!is.null(scope$config$input)) {
 stopifnot(digest::digest(file=scope$config$input,algo='sha256')==scope$config$input_sha256)
 provenance<-jsonlite::fromJSON(scope$config$input)
 source_version<-provenance$probability_version
}
probability_version<-NULL
stopifnot(identical(issues,unlist(receipts$top2$config$issues)),
 !anyDuplicated(issues),identical(issues,sort(issues)))
# All plans are already frozen. Read byte-verified labels only at this boundary.
labels<-bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(cfg$labels)),function(i)
 diagnostic_read_verified_csv(cfg$labels$path[i],cfg$labels$sha256[i],
 cols(issue='c',provider_id='c')) |>
 select(issue,slot,provider_id,handicap,status,actual_direction,spf_sp)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(labels[c('issue','slot')]))
groups<-list();tickets<-list();input_counts<-list();unavailable<-list()
for(id in issues) {
 plans<-list()
 for(k in names(receipts)) {
  b<-receipts[[k]]$bindings[[id]]
  stopifnot(digest::digest(file=b$path,algo='sha256')==b$sha256)
  z<-readRDS(b$path)
  stopifnot(identical(z$seal,digest::digest(z[names(z)!='seal'],algo='sha256')),
    z$issue==id)
  plans[[k]]<-z
 }
 eight_strategy_validate_pair(plans$joint,plans$top2)
 unavailable[[id]]<-eight_strategy_unavailable_labels(bind_rows(plans$joint$fixtures),filter(labels,issue==id))
 if(nrow(unavailable[[id]])>0)next
 input_counts[[id]]<-tibble(issue=id,fixtures=nrow(plans$top2$fresh$fixtures),
  eligible_fixtures=length(plans$top2$fresh$eligible),
  fresh_candidates=length(plans$top2$fresh$groups),
  expanded_candidates=n_distinct(plans$top2$expanded$groups$group_id),
  source_sha256=plans$joint$source_sha256)
 v<-eight_strategy_probability_version(bind_rows(plans$joint$fixtures),source_version,model_label)
 if(is.null(probability_version))probability_version<-v else stopifnot(identical(probability_version,v))
 admitted_labels<-eight_strategy_ready_labels(bind_rows(plans$joint$fixtures),filter(labels,issue==id))
 j<-n7_purchase_settle(plans$joint,admitted_labels,2,.65)
 f<-top2_fresh_settle(plans$top2$fresh,admitted_labels) |>
  filter(policy=='TOP2_DIVERSE') |>
  transmute(issue,policy,sleeve_id=as.double(group),stake,depth=128L,
    coverage=probability,expected_gross,hit,gross)
 x<-joint_candidate_settle(plans$top2$expanded,admitted_labels)
 t<-x$tickets |> filter(policy %in% c('HARD1','HARD2','WITHIN0'))
 g<-t |> group_by(issue,policy,group_id) |> summarise(stake=n()*2,
   depth=n(),coverage=sum(probability),expected_gross=sum(probability*estimated_payout),
   hit=any(hit),gross=sum(gross),.groups='drop') |> rename(sleeve_id=group_id)
 groups[[id]]<-bind_rows(j,f,g);tickets[[id]]<-t
}
unavailable<-bind_rows(unavailable)
issues<-setdiff(requested_issues,unavailable$issue)
stopifnot(length(issues)>0)
groups<-bind_rows(groups)
policies<-c('JOINT','DEPTH_OPEN','U4','CONFIDENCE','TOP2_DIVERSE','HARD1','HARD2','WITHIN0')
rows<-groups |> group_by(issue,policy) |> summarise(stake=sum(stake),gross=sum(gross),hits=sum(hit),.groups='drop')
rows<-expand_grid(issue=issues,policy=policies) |>
 left_join(rows,by=c('issue','policy'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
 mutate(across(c(stake,gross,hits),~replace_na(.x,0)),net=gross-stake,
  model=probability_version,probability_version=probability_version,budget_cny=1024,cash_cny=1024-stake,
  status=if_else(stake>0,'COMPLETE','NO_BET'),
  stage=sprintf('BLOCK_%02d',(match(issue,issues)-1L)%/%100L+1L))
stopifnot(nrow(rows)==length(issues)*8,all(rows$stake<=1024))
result<-legacy_strategy_comparison(rows,issues,unique(rows$stage),'JOINT',100000)
tail_diagnostics<-eight_strategy_tail_diagnostics(result$curves,c(1L,3L,5L))
result$trimmed<-tail_diagnostics$trimmed
result$streaks<-tail_diagnostics$streaks
result$summary |> filter(evaluation=='ALL') |> knitr::kable(digits=2)
```

## 结算不可用期次

以下异常导致整期对八个方案统一暂不结算。投注计划保持冻结，不将缺价算作未中或使用估算价格替代。

```{r}
unavailable |> knitr::kable()
```

## 收益与回撤

```{r}
curve<-result$curves |> filter(evaluation=='ALL',accounting_basis=='FUNDED')
plot_data<-curve |> select(period,policy,equity_cny,drawdown_cny) |>
 pivot_longer(c(equity_cny,drawdown_cny),names_to='measure',values_to='CNY')
p<-ggplot(plot_data,aes(period,CNY,color=policy))+geom_line(linewidth=.6)+
 facet_wrap(~measure,ncol=1,scales='free_y')+theme_minimal()+
 scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_comma())+
 labs(x='Issue order',y='CNY',color='Strategy')
p
```

## 固定100期分段与去极值

分段独立初始化本金；全样本曲线连续运行，不在分界补充资金。
去极值只剔除正净收益期，不足指定数量时如实报告实际剔除数。
连续未中按实际投注期序列统计，忽略现金期及资金不足后的停投期。

```{r}
result$summary |> filter(evaluation!='ALL',accounting_basis=='FUNDED') |>
 select(evaluation,policy,issues,stake_cny,net_cny,roi_percent,hit_issues,profit_issues,max_drawdown_cny) |>
 knitr::kable(digits=2)
result$trimmed |> filter(evaluation=='ALL',accounting_basis=='FUNDED') |> knitr::kable(digits=2)
result$complementarity |> filter(evaluation=='ALL',accounting_basis=='FUNDED') |> knitr::kable(digits=3)
result$streaks |> filter(evaluation=='ALL',accounting_basis=='FUNDED') |> knitr::kable()
```

## 输出与范围

```{r}
dir.create(cfg$output,recursive=TRUE)
write_csv(unavailable,file.path(cfg$output,'unavailable-issues.csv'))
write_csv(rows,file.path(cfg$output,'rows.csv'));write_csv(groups,file.path(cfg$output,'groups.csv'))
write_csv(bind_rows(input_counts),file.path(cfg$output,'input-counts.csv'))
for(n in names(result))write_csv(result[[n]],file.path(cfg$output,paste0(n,'.csv')))
ggsave(file.path(cfg$output,'equity-drawdown.png'),p,width=13,height=9,dpi=160)
files<-list.files(cfg$output,full.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(identical(code,setNames(lapply(code_files,function(f)digest::digest(file=file.path(root,f),algo='sha256')),code_files)))
jsonlite::write_json(list(status='SETTLED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW',config=cfg,
 requested_issues=requested_issues,issues=issues,policies=policies,historical_admission=FALSE,
 code=code,
 files=setNames(lapply(files,function(f)digest::digest(file=f,algo='sha256')),basename(files))),
 file.path(cfg$output,'receipt.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE,digits=NA)
data.frame(first=issues[1],last=tail(issues,1),issues=length(issues),probability_version=probability_version) |> knitr::kable()
```

本报告的输入范围由冻结清单决定，不能自动声称覆盖全部已验收历史。
旧U3/U6压单策略的原配置复现、早期范围核验、独立重放和最终研究结论
应与本计算报告共同交付；本入口的成功渲染不单独构成整项验收。
